free_text.text: صندوق التكافل الجديد يجمع اشتراكات التبرع من الأعضاء. The new takaful fund pools tabarru contributions, but the surplus-sharing clause is vague and may involve gharar in the payout terms.

operator_notes: Worked bilingual example: Arabic plus English takaful text with a gharar surface form. Exercises Arabic exact-substring matching, code-point offsets, and the locked one-item-per-term rule.
